hooks.command: if [ "$FILE_PATH" = "hardware-configuration.nix" ] || [[ "$FILE_PATH" == *hardware-configuration.nix* ]]; then echo 'Error: hardware-configuration.nix is auto-generated by nixos-generate-config. Edit configuration.nix or modules/ instead.' >&2; exit 1; fi
if [ "$FILE_PATH" = "flake.lock" ] || [[ "$FILE_PATH" == *flake.lock* ]]; then echo 'Error: flake.lock is auto-managed. Run "nix flake update" to update inputs.' >&2; exit 1; fi
if [[ "$FILE_PATH" == *.nix ]]; then nix flake check; fi

if [[ "$COMMAND" == kubectl*delete*pods*--all* ]] || [[ "$COMMAND" == kubectl*delete*pods*-A* ]]; then echo 'ERROR: Forbidden bulk kubectl delete. Be specific: kubectl delete pods -n <namespace> -l <label>' >&2; exit 1; fi

if [[ "$COMMAND" == kubectl*scale*deploy*--all* ]] || [[ "$COMMAND" == kubectl*scale*--all-namespaces* ]]; then echo 'ERROR: Forbidden bulk kubectl scale. Be specific: kubectl scale deploy -n <namespace> <name> --replicas=1' >&2; exit 1; fi

if [[ "$COMMAND" == kubectl*delete*deployment* ]] && [[ "$COMMAND" != *--replicas=0* ]]; then echo 'WARNING: Always scale to 0 before deleting deployments: kubectl scale deploy <name> --replicas=0 && kubectl delete deploy <name>' >&2; fi
